## Context / Problem

`tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py::test_a_sweep_with_nothing_selected_still_pushes` is named for, and its docstring describes, the `Nothing to do.` early return in `compact_all_cli` (`src/rebar/_commands/compact.py:524-527`, the `total_needs == 0` branch that calls `_best_effort_push`, defined at `compact.py:277`). It never reaches that branch. `tests/conftest.py:664-665` sets `REBAR_COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS=0`, so the backfill arm selects the seeded snapshot-less ticket whatever `REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD=9999` says; the sweep folds it and the fold path's own push (`compact.py:559`) satisfies `assert calls`.

Measured 2026-11-03 at `90d57e392ba` (session a85e3cd3, while working soldierly-arbitrary-hackee): with a scratch pytest plugin replacing `compact._best_effort_push` by a no-op, the test still PASSED. In the same setup, `compact_all_cli(["--dry-run"])` printed `Tickets needing compaction    : 1`, not `Nothing to do.`.

Sibling check: the 2 sibling push tests in the same file (`test_dry_run_never_pushes`, `test_no_commit_never_pushes`) were fixed by soldierly-arbitrary-hackee (Gerrit 3288, `731a2328295`). The other `REBAR_COMPACT_THRESHOLD=9999` tests (`tests/unit/test_compact_trigger.py`, 3 tests) give the ticket a SNAPSHOT first, so the backfill arm cannot select it; they do not share this defect and are out of scope.

## Approach

Follow the 3288 precedent in the test only:
- set `REBAR_COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS` to `_HOUR_NS` (1 hour) in the test, so the fresh seeded events are not foldable and nothing is selected;
- capture `rc = compact_all_cli([], ...)`, add the `capsys` fixture, and assert `rc == 0` and `"Nothing to do."` in captured stdout, in addition to the existing `assert calls`.

No source change, no new fixture, no autouse fixture.

## Scope

- `tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py` — strengthen `test_a_sweep_with_nothing_selected_still_pushes`.

## Testing

Failing-first proof with a scratch-only pytest plugin (in `.rebar/scratch/`, loaded with `pytest -p`, never committed) that replaces `rebar._commands.compact._best_effort_push` with a no-op:
- before the change the test PASSES under the plugin (the defect);
- after the change the test FAILS under the plugin, and PASSES without it.

`pytest tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py` passes; `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass with the worktree `.venv/bin` first on PATH.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The test sets a 1-hour `REBAR_COMPACTION_HORIZON_NS` and asserts exit 0 and `Nothing to do.` in captured stdout, in addition to `assert calls`.
- [ ] The test FAILS when `_best_effort_push` is replaced by a no-op (scratch plugin), and PASSES without the plugin.
- [ ] `pytest tests/unit/test_compact_all_selection.py`, `make lint`, and `make typecheck` pass.
